Scenario fixture: rgaa-autocomplete-user-field (RGAA 11.13.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form auf_case_NN. 11.13.1 applies to fields about the user. A malformed value naming a field of the list fails; a field that looks like personal data with no valid value is asked about; a field that does not concern the user is out of scope.

01 — FAIL: "email home", which names a listed field but is malformed
02 — CANTTELL: email field with no autocomplete
03 — CANTTELL: "Nom" with autocomplete="off"
04 — PASS: well-formed value
05 — NOT APPLICABLE: invalid value on a field that does not concern the user
06 — NOT APPLICABLE: search form
